reviews.title: Great fans. Lots of cfm and quiet as well.
reviews.comment: replaced non pwm fans in a new Silverstone SETA D1 case. Fans fit well and supply boat loads of air. ASUS MB fan controls work well with these fans. At high speeds these are loud. These also look well-made and should last a good 5 years.  So, these move lots of air but be prepared for loads of fan noise at higher rpm to max speed. Last thing to mention is the mounting screws. Really these require a #1 phillips and that is too small. At least supply #2 Phillips Arctic. Would buy again unless I find something with same cfm and static pressure and half the noise at same price point. Oh, there isn`t anything out there right now.
reviews.author: Ordinary Joe Blow

reviews.title: Fantastic quality, would buy again.
reviews.comment: Quiet for full speed, not perfectly silent, but good enough compared to the server grade fan I had in there before. I have a single exhaust fan spot in my case and a 7900 GRE that gets VERY hot. The exhaust fan that came with the case was severely inadequate. I tried the server grade fan but it sounded like a leaf blower. This doesn't move quite as much CFM's as the server fan, but it bridges the gap by moving enough to keep it cool while not sounding like a jet engine.
reviews.author: Christopher May

reviews.title: Excellent fan, abusrd screws.
reviews.comment:
4/5 stars ONLY because of the screws.  Everything else on these is awesome.  VERY quiet, move tons of air and can ramp up to crazy speeds IF you need it.  Honestly, I just have 2 on the front of my Fractal North and at 600 rpm idle, they keep everything extremely cool.  No weird humming or issues.  Highly recommend.
The downside:  Idk what Artic is doing, but these screws are just hilariously bad.  When you actually put them into the fan, it strips the screw of all the paint and creates shards of metal.  They are SO difficult to screw in, especially in semi tight cases, I had to use a socket-ed wrench with screwdriver bit to actually get these in.  Even after i pre-installed the screws.  No joke.  Artic, fix this.  Insanity.
reviews.author: Jeff Lombardi

reviews.title: Quality fans, solid company
reviews.comment: Great quality fans, they help keep your PC cool.  Going with artic or noctua is a no brainer, it's a fan it does it's job, I would buy again if I ever get a bigger case but I am sure the one's I bought for my case will last a good while. They'rea  bit noisy on full blast but so is any case fan.
reviews.author: Diego

reviews.title: 90% as good as a Noctua for 60% off.
reviews.comment:
I have a few Noctuas and fans of a few other brands. I want the highest performance for the lowest noise AND cost. On my Thermalright 140mm dual tower CPU cooler I replaced the fans with Icegale xtra 140mm and 120mm fans which are the most powerful PC fans on the market. CPU is a  5.7ghz overclocked 9700x. After getting a new TV and playing games on it with surround sound instead of on a monitor with headphones, the Icegale fans were just too noisy.
Putting the P12 Pro and P14 Pro on my CPU cooler the temps when put under 150w stress test increased from 82C to 86C. According to the box they are supposed to have higher static pressure than the Icegale but apparently not. However, that is still very well within reasonable temps during a stress test and best of all, I would guess about a 50% reduction in noise overall. From a PC sounding like a server rack to sounding like being near a duct vent when the air kicks on. Significant improvement!
Cannot recommend these enough
reviews.author: hanna
